strongest_angle: Examining the unfolding criminal investigation, federal search warrants, and grand jury subpoenas targeting Democratic Representative Ilhan Omar and her family members regarding immigration status paperwork.

key_facts.fact: Federal authorities seized the mobile phone of Democratic Representative Ilhan Omar as part of an ongoing criminal investigation.
Multiple relatives of Representative Ilhan Omar received grand jury subpoenas concerning immigration history and paperwork.
Homeland Security Investigations agents executed a search warrant approved by a court at the home of Representative Ilhan Omar in Washington DC on October 12.
